items: Most guests only leave reviews when they are very happy or very unhappy, so you need to ask for feedback at the right moment and in the right place.
The best moments to ask are right after the meal, at payment, through a QR code on the receipt or table, and by SMS within a few hours.
A good survey routes dine-in and delivery guests separately, asks for overall and category ratings, drills down on low scores and includes an NPS question.
End your survey with a reward and a follow-up promise for unhappy guests; Momos sends positive responses to Google and negative ones into customer recovery.
